notes: Make ResultParser an abstract base class whose subclasses register themselves with __init_subclass__(suffix=...) in the class attribute ResultParser.registry (suffix -> class) and keep the suffix as cls.suffix; a subclass with no suffix raises TypeError, and a suffix that's already registered raises ValueError. for_file(path) returns an instance of the parser whose suffix is the longest one the path ends with (case-sensitive), or raises LookupError. summary(text) returns {"parser": class name, "passed": n, "failed": n, "failed_tests": sorted names}. Formats: .json is a list of {"name", "status"} objects (anything that isn't a list raises ValueError; invalid JSON raises ValueError naturally); .csv has a header row with name and status columns in any order (a missing column raises ValueError, and quoted fields may contain commas); .tap result lines start with "ok " or "not ok " followed by a number, " - " and the name (like "not ok 4 - attach"), and every other line is ignored. A test passed only when its status is exactly pass (a missing status counts as failed). The two stub parsers and exercise are provided.
